contact_point.query_text:
Photographic role: A person presents an ordinary fabric object on open palms to another person whose inspection tool touches a tag attached to that same object. Show each owner, support surface and contact endpoint.
Scene context: Three people occupy a barracks sleeping room. The submitted towel is near the camera and the main face remains visible.

procedure_step.query_text:
Photographic role: An ordinary barracks chore is handled as an elaborate formal inspection, with one visible step, a submitted everyday object and an evident result.
Scene context: A participant offers a folded towel in a communal sleeping room. An inspector marks a paper tag while a peer waits.

proxemics.query_text:
Photographic role: A solemn small group arranges access to an ordinary barracks inspection station, one person presenting an everyday object and another waiting behind. Their spacing and directed attention imply disproportionate hierarchy.
Scene context: The central participant holds a folded towel; an inspector is at a table and a waiting participant has another towel.

__baseline_prompt__.query_text: A satirical photograph of absurd barracks ritual, observed with quiet documentary precision. The central participant is a woman whose visible face and hair follow the supplied portrait: large brown eyes, a soft oval face, a small nose and full rosy lips, with a dark chin-length bob and wispy bangs. She participates in an ordinary shared-living chore treated as a formal military ceremony. In a cramped communal sleeping room with steel bunk beds, she stands at the near left of a waist-high inspection table, dressed in a plain olive short-sleeved utility shirt and dark fatigue trousers. She presents one carefully folded white towel flat across both upturned palms at waist height, her elbows close to her sides. A large blank paper tag is clipped over the towel's near right corner. At the near right, a seated inspector in the same work clothes leans slightly forward, his right forearm descending into a vertical rubber stamp whose flat base touches that paper tag. His left hand rests on the table, physically separate from her hands. Their hands, the stamp and the tag form one clear foreground triangle, each with an unobstructed silhouette. Another folded towel on the table bears a conspicuous red circular approval mark; behind her, one waiting participant holds a similar unmarked towel and watches the stamp. The central woman keeps her chin raised and her lips gently parted, a composed expression whose slight incredulity makes the ceremony feel disproportionate to this ordinary towel. The background bunks contain thin gray blankets and neatly paired slippers. Frame a three-person medium-wide photograph from just above table height, with the central face and the complete towel-to-stamp contact large enough to inspect together. Soft morning window light crosses the face and white terry cloth, while flat ceiling light leaves the institutional room readable. Muted olive and gray make the small red approval mark the only strong color accent; retain natural skin texture and the palpable weight of fabric in her palms.
